title: 第19章 一块木头都没捡回来？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一阵温热的白汽在面前升腾。

    方芸捧着一个打磨规整的木碗，小心翼翼地递到他手边。

    清澈的开水在碗里微微荡漾。

    “趁热喝。”

    许默接过木碗，温热的触感顺着指尖蔓延至全身。

    “谢谢，手艺不错。”

    他低下头，抿了一口热水，眼里充满自嘲。

    在永恒领域，他说谢谢的次数，竟然比过去一年加起来都多。

    水源危机暂时解除，又搭上了杨军这条线，两人紧绷到极致的神经总算有了片刻的喘息。

    许默转身回到工作台前，开始消耗剩余的木材制作一些备用的采集工具。

    夜色愈发深沉，方芸再次端着一碗热水走过来。

    许默接过水，有点明白了。

    “怎么，急着让我敲床，结果自己出去半天，一块木头都没捡回来？”

    方芸眼帘低垂，罕见的示弱。

    “林子里危险……我一直负责警戒，怕有东西突然扑出来，没敢分心去抠材料。”

    许默没有接话。

    他随手调出背包，将剩下的几单位木材划给庇护所储物箱。

    方芸很是高兴，这代表许默给她共享材料了。

    然而下一句，许默又高冷起来。

    “自己去工作台合一张床出来。”

    深夜。

    新合成的木床紧挨着石壁。

    方芸蜷缩在僵硬的木板上，单薄的战术背心根本抵挡不住这刺骨的严寒。

    她只能将白天脱下的外套死死裹在身上，借着微弱的火光，那盈盈一握的腰肢和紧绷的曲线在阴影中若隐若现，透着一股致命的诱惑力。

    许默坐在另一张床上，目光扫过她微微颤抖的娇躯。

    最终，还是心软。

    他面无表情地打开系统商城。

    十点幸存点瞬间扣除。

    一团厚实的草料被褥凭空出现，在半空中划过一道抛物线，精准无误地砸在方芸头上。

    方芸猛地惊醒，扯下头顶带着干燥草香的被褥。

    她愣愣地看着不远处的男人，死死咬住下唇，眼底第一次泛起毫无伪装的感激。

    许默早就翻身平躺，拉过自己那床破被子。

    “不用谢。”

    “我只是不想在这种环境里，因为某人冻得直哆嗦而犯下什么不可挽回的错误。”

    方芸呆滞了两秒，脑海中好不容易想明白了他的潜台词。

    一股滚烫的热劲儿顺着耳根一路烧到脖颈。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A burst of warm white steam rose in front of me.

Fang Yun held a neatly polished wooden bowl and handed it to him carefully.

The clear boiling water rippled slightly in the bowl.

"Drink it while it's hot."

Xu Mo took the wooden bowl, and the warm touch spread to his whole body along his fingertips.

"Thank you, the workmanship is good."

He lowered his head and took a sip of hot water, his eyes full of self-mockery.

In the eternal realm, he said thank you more times than in the past year combined.

The water crisis was temporarily resolved, and Yang Jun was on the line again. The two of them finally had a moment of respite from their extremely tense nerves.

Xu Mo turned back to the workbench and began to consume the remaining wood to make some spare gathering tools.

The night became darker and darker, and Fang Yun came over again carrying a bowl of hot water.

Xu Mo took the water and understood a little bit.

"Why, you asked me to knock on the bed in a hurry, but you went out for a long time and didn't pick up a piece of wood?"

Fang Yun lowered her eyes, showing a rare sign of weakness.

“It’s dangerous in the woods... I’ve always been on guard, afraid that something might suddenly pounce out, so I didn’t dare to get distracted and pick up materials.”

Xu Mo did not answer the call.

He casually took out his backpack and allocated the remaining units of wood to the shelter storage boxes.

Fang Yun was very happy, which meant that Xu Mo shared the materials with her.

However, in the next sentence, Xu Mo became cold and aloof again.

"Go to the workbench and put it together on a bed."

Late at night.

The newly synthesized wooden bed is next to the stone wall.

Fang Yun huddled on the stiff wooden board, her thin tactical vest unable to withstand the biting cold.

She could only wrap the coat she had taken off during the day tightly around her body. In the dim light of the fire, her voluptuous waist and tight curves were looming in the shadows, exuding a fatal allure.

Xu Mo sat on the other bed and glanced at her slightly trembling body.

In the end, I still relented.

He opened the system mall with an expressionless face.

Ten survival points are deducted instantly.

A thick ball of straw bedding appeared out of thin air, drew a parabola in mid-air, and hit Fang Yun on the head accurately.

Fang Yun woke up suddenly and pulled off the quilt that smelled of dry grass above her head.

She stared blankly at the man not far away, biting her lower lip, and for the first time there was unpretended gratitude in her eyes.

Xu Mo had already turned over and lay down on his back, pulling over his shabby quilt.

"You're welcome."

“I just don’t want to make any irreversible mistakes in this environment because someone is shivering from the cold.”

Fang Yun was stunned for two seconds, and finally understood his subtext in her mind.

A scalding heat ran from the base of the ears to the neck.
